entry.title: Luxor Resort & Casino
entry.note: Exact-QID pyramid envelope fixes the anchor and almost-cardinal axes. Independently mapped northern tower steps and eastern Sphinx body/head/obelisk agree with operator plan and contractor aerial, resolving the signed phase. GroundY0 at pyramid/entrance datum; the sculpted body retains its transverse passage. Mapped pyramid111m and obelisk62/70m tags are rejected in favor of published106.7m and maker140ft. Fine sculptural and podium offsets remain reconstructed. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
